reason: We have 1,350 members, most of them over 60, and a running system. I'm not moving all of that to two founders whose only pilot club isn't even live yet, and I don't have the evenings to babysit a migration.
objection: No other club uses it yet: where are the references? If two people get sick or quit, my members can't book a tee time and I'm the one taking the calls.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three comparable clubs running it live for a full season, that I can phone and visit, plus a contract that guarantees our data and support if the company stops.
